analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일 연속 매수 우위 유지했으나, 금일 RSI 62.6으로 과매수 구간에서 냉각 시작. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세 지속하나 이전 대비 상승폭 둔화. 5일 평균 거래량 대비 0.64배로 거래량 위축. 20일 저가 대비 5일 저가 상승으로 Higher Low 패턴은 유지되나, 변동성 감소 및 RSI 냉각으로 추가 상승 동력 약화. 따라서 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 sessions showed buy bias, but today RSI cooled from overbought at 62.6. MACD histogram continues to improve but at a slower pace. Volume is weak at 0.64x the 5-day average. Higher Low pattern is intact with 5-day low above 20-day low, but reduced volatility and RSI cooling suggest waning upward momentum. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($2,680.92) vs SMA5($2,699.2)/SMA20($2,566.66)/SMA50($2,372.26): Below short-term SMA5, above mid-term SMA20/50
· High position relative to SMA100($2,083.29)/SMA200($2,097.56): Mid-to-long term trend strength maintained

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (72.2→62.6): Cooling from overbought territory, approaching neutral zone
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (12.6032→3.1111): Improvement continues but pace is slowing, weakening bullish expansion signal

[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($2,626.87): Support based on Pivot S1($2,424.09) and SMA20
· Swing Resistance ($2,720.27): Potential for strengthening uptrend upon breakout
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low): Confirmed uptrend maintenance
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.64x): Reduced confidence in price movement
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Uptrend): Wait and see; consider selling on RSI below 50 or MACD deterioration, consider buying on resistance breakout
